require 'json';require 'digest'

raise 'Incomplete' unless r['status']=='characterized'
{'probe_sha256'=>a+'/task-allocation-probe','binary_sha256'=>a+'/candidate-kujo','runner_sha256'=>'benchmarks/langarena/probes/collection-gap-isolation.rb'}.each{|key,path|raise 'Identity '+key unless r[key]==Digest::SHA256.file(path).hexdigest}
shapes=%w[dict_one_int dict_two_int dict_one_float struct_row_one struct_row_two dict_row_two array_row_one deep_row_one dict_dict_one struct_dict_one]
cases=shapes.product([2,128,2048],%w[once fresh],[16,32]);keys=%w[shape width snapshot calls mode]
raise 'Rows coverage' unless r['rows'].map{|x|x.values_at(*keys)}.sort==cases.flat_map{|x|%w[vm jit].map{|m|x+[m]}}.sort
raise 'Semantics coverage' unless r['semantics'].map{|x|x.values_at(*keys)}.sort==cases.flat_map{|x|%w[vm interpreter jit].map{|m|x+[m]}}.sort
r['sources'].each{|h,s|raise 'Source digest' unless h==Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(s)}
(r['rows']+r['semantics']).each do |x|
 folder=d+'/'+x.values_at('shape','width','snapshot').join('-')
 {'source_sha256'=>folder+"/calls-#{x['calls']}.kujo",'module_sha256'=>folder+'/owner.kujo'}.each{|k,p|raise 'Fixture identity' unless r['sources'].key?(x[k])&&Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==x[k]}
 raise 'Semantic failure' if x.key?('exit')&&x['exit']!=0
end
deltas=r['rows'].group_by{|x|x.values_at('shape','width','snapshot','mode')}.map do |key,rows|
 first,last=rows.sort_by{|x|x['calls']}
 {'shape'=>key[0],'width'=>key[1],'snapshot'=>key[2],'mode'=>key[3],'requests_per_added_call'=>(last['requests']-first['requests'])/16.0,'bytes_per_added_call'=>(last['bytes']-first['bytes'])/16.0}
end
raise 'Delta mismatch' unless deltas==r['deltas']
r['runtime_commit']='36b8006d1bd3af2883a6f22e6d839efb3c42ea11';r['verification_source']=File.read(__FILE__)
File.write(d+'/verified.json',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")
puts 'Verified240 allocation measurements/360 semantic cases, exact coverage, identities and deltas'
